description: County Road Pavement Condition is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Condition assessment of County road pavement segments by type of road (Collectors and Arterials, and Local Access Roads). Conditions are rated on a scale of good, fair, and poor. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are collectors, arterials, local access road, road, pavement. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: Pierce County. The portal shows 2024-02-08 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
